verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs confirm an iOS and Android mobile app for on-call (rootly-docs-43, truncated). The mobile app also shows an Incident Summary card and the Rootly AI agent on incidents (rootly-docs-62), and escalation policies are built around alerts being acknowledged in time (rootly-docs-7, rootly-docs-39). However, nothing in the pack shows that acknowledging, escalating, or resolving can actually be done from the phone. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of acknowledge, escalate, and resolve actions in the mobile app; mobile push or critical-alert notification behavior; and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
